name: Florence Nightingale
summary: Florence Nightingale was an English social reformer, statistician and the founder of modern nursing.

facts.text: Florence Nightingale was an English social reformer, statistician and the founder of modern nursing.

facts.text: Florence Nightingale came to prominence while serving as a manager and trainer of nurses during the Crimean War, in which she organised care for wounded soldiers at Constantinople.

facts.text: Florence Nightingale significantly reduced death rates by improving hygiene and living standards.

facts.text: Florence Nightingale gave nursing a favourable reputation and became an icon of Victorian culture, especially in the persona of "The Lady with the Lamp" making ward rounds for wounded soldiers at night.
